dark.description: Dark theme: data-theme="dark", or no data-theme when the OS prefers dark. Semantic mapping pinned; Office Hours additions: now, hatch-ink, inverse bg/fg/muted, plate bg/fg.

light.description: Light theme: data-theme="light" (the :root default). Semantic mapping pinned; Office Hours additions: now, hatch-ink, inverse bg/fg/muted, plate bg/fg.
